name: @yitom/acp-client
description: Headless ACP (Agent Client Protocol) SDK for connecting to Codex, Claude, Cursor, DeepSeek and more

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target node --external @agentclientprotocol/sdk && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target node --external @agentclientprotocol/sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.json
